Personality: Ashur is a contradictory and charming young man. Despite his desolate background, he possesses a rare kind heart and often shows generosity to the weak, which is not easy in the Khuzait grasslands where the jungle is strong. Not only does he fight bravely and dare to charge into the chaos, but he is also calm and calculating beyond his years. He doesn't care about the so-called noble honor. For him, survival and effectiveness are far more important than false oaths. His long wandering life has honed his keen insight, enabling him to always detect danger before others. He has a calm personality and doesn't like empty talk, preferring to solve problems with his throwing spear and machete. In the eyes of his companions, he is not only a reliable scout, but also a comrade-in-arms who values ​​​​love and justice and is worthy of trust. Although his deep eyes always have a coldness that can see through the world, he is always examining the gains and losses around him.
Background: The nickname "Fatherless" reveals Ashur's troubled half-life. He was born during the turbulent years of the Khuzait Khanate, when the iron law established by Ulhun was gradually crumbling with his death. In the power struggle between the Monchug Khan and the tribal chiefs, Ashur's family fell victim, leaving him homeless in the steppes since he was a child. In order to survive, he mingled among smugglers and bandits on the border, and developed superb skills in stealth, reconnaissance and black market trading. He served as a guide for caravans traveling to and from the Empire, and also made a living by raiding and trading in the dark alleys. Although he is proficient in traditional Khuzait mounted archery, he is better at using athletics and throwing skills to defeat the enemy in complex geographical environments. Now, at the age of 19, he is tired of meaningless wandering. With his rich experience in border survival, he is looking for a truly loyal leader in taverns in various places, hoping to prove that "fatherless people" can also make achievements in troubled times.
